status: Unadopted literature suggestion; not an execution protocol, grant of data access, gate or source change
name: Frozen graph-conditioned hidden residual readout
task_scope: One existing node-classification block with four source-qualified private penultimate feature interfaces. This packet does not certify such caches exist; LP requires a separately declared query/endpoint interface.

inputs.h: Per-node four private penultimate representations h_m; concatenate without assuming channel semantic alignment. Normalize from the declared fusion-training role only.
inputs.q: All four native member logits z_m, with native mean-logit anchor z_bar.
inputs.g: One fixed labels-free graph summary: arithmetic-mean member probability vector averaged over canonical visible neighbors, plus log(1+degree) and an isolate indicator. Row-mean operator on unchanged canonical observed topology; zero-neighbor summary defined as the node pooled probability. No label injection, graph learning or visibility change.

formula: z_F(i)=mean_m z_m(i)+V ReLU(W [concat_m h_m(i), concat_m z_m(i), g(i)]+b)+a
head: One hidden layer; initial r=32 when class count C≤32, else r=C, fixed before outcomes. Zero last-layer and output-bias initialization reproduces native mean pooling initially. Freeze all backbone/routes/classifier parameters and train the readout CE only; no KD or member retraining.
cost: Full dense M4 route work remains. If hidden states are not saved, all member extraction forwards are additional charged cost. One labels-free class-width sparse neighbor aggregation and head train/inference/storage are extra. No sparse-compute saving or cheaper-than-M4 claim.

core_comparators.purpose: Served reference; no extra supervised fit.

core_comparators.arm: Same residual nonlinear head on all member logits and exactly the same g, without h
core_comparators.purpose: Separates information in hidden states from nonlinear stacking/graph context. Match total trainable parameter budget by increasing this smaller-input head width; disclose runtime differences.

core_comparators.arm: Same residual hidden-bank/logit/context head with ReLU replaced by identity
core_comparators.purpose: A factored linear feature-fusion comparator at the same parameter count; r≥C allows full linear class readout. Separates nonlinear joint readout from PCL-style linear feature fusion.

attribution_controls.arm: Same nonlinear hidden-bank/logit head with graph-context coordinates fixed to a declared constant
attribution_controls.purpose: Isolates information in graph context with architecture/parameter budget preserved. Needed to attribute a graph ingredient.

attribution_controls.arm: Parameter-budget-matched nonlinear single-private-feature head plus all member logits and the same g
attribution_controls.purpose: Tests whether access to multiple private feature banks earns more than a capable one-route readout. Fit each of four candidate single heads under the same declared recipe, choose using only the fusion-selection role, and disclose four-head selection cost.

capable_single: An unrestricted single readout given the full concatenated hidden bank, logits and g contains the proposed one-hidden-layer residual head. In fact the proposed head is itself one readout on that bank. This is a representation/capacity description, not a reason to reject utility. No distinct ensemble-fusion novelty claim is available merely from relabeling it. Mean+all centered contrasts is an invertible coordinate change when dimensions align; it adds no information by itself.
additional_baseline: Pooled TRAIN-only Correct-and-Smooth is a relevant graph-error baseline only if its label use, sign, scales, graph operator, clipping and selection budget are declared/matched. It is not part of the labels-free learned-head mechanism. Per-member common-linear correction then mean is redundant; native nonlinear variants need explicit accounting.

supervision.preferred: Genuinely separate fusion-training and fusion-selection roles that were unavailable to base fitting/selection, or prospective out-of-fold base predictions with heldout meta roles. All comparator heads get identical labels/examples/class weighting and declared regularization/selection budgets.
supervision.already_selected_checkpoints: Splitting existing VALID after those labels selected the base checkpoint does not undo base-selection dependence. TRAIN-output fitting remains in-sample to the base and may overfit. Such cached-only use is an exploratory analysis with those risks explicitly disclosed; it cannot be called an independently heldout fusion test. Cleaner cross-fitting/prospective roles add base fits and are outside a free cached-only claim.
supervision.test: No TEST opening or evaluation authorized here; existing gate/selector/confirmation remain unchanged.

success_question: Heldout served NLL and task accuracy versus C0, C1 and C2, with paired identical base blocks. A graph attribution additionally needs C4; a multiple-private-bank attribution needs C5. Weight spread, hidden variance, member disagreement or common-error rescue count alone do not establish utility.
falsifier: No advantage over nonlinear logits+same graph context leaves extra hidden-bank usefulness unsupported. Matching linear hidden readout leaves the need for nonlinear fusion unsupported. Matching graph-free head leaves the graph-context explanation unsupported. Matching capable single-feature head leaves the multiple-private-bank explanation unsupported.
no_empirical_claim: No fits, payload reads, numbers, minimum effect threshold or admission decision were produced.
